description: This file defines a Python class 'ChromiumCommit' for managing and analyzing Chromium Git commits, including retrieving commit details, counting behind commits, and generating patches. It interacts with external Git commands and references specific Chromium repository directories.

classes.name: ChromiumCommit
classes.description: A class for representing and interacting with a specific Chromium Git commit, providing methods to retrieve commit info, changed files, and generate patches.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a ChromiumCommit object with host, sha, or position, resolving sha if only position is provided.

methods.name: num_behind_master
methods.description: Returns the number of commits this commit is behind the origin/master branch.

methods.name: position_to_sha
methods.description: Converts a commit position string to a SHA hash using git.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Retrieves the author name and email of the commit.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Retrieves the full commit message including subject and body.

methods.name: filtered_changed_files
methods.description: Returns a list of changed files in the commit, filtered to exclude certain files and baselines.

methods.name: is_baseline
methods.description: Checks if a filename is a baseline file based on its suffix.

methods.name: format_patch
methods.description: Generates a patch for the commit with only exportable changes.
